title: Teodoro backs tight scrutiny of China state firm funds sent to PH execs
summary: MANILA, Philippines—Any funds given to a public official by a Chinese state-owned enterprise must be subjected to the “highest level of scrutiny,” according to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Any funds given to a public official by a Chinese state-owned enterprise must be subjected to the “highest level of scrutiny,” according to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Teodoro was commenting on alleged deposits by Chinese firms to companies linked to Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio. “Sa ngayon (For now), we are still waiting for the investigative agencies to complete their investigation. It’s ongoing,” he said in an interview at the Senate on Monday, explaining that the probe is being conducted by other agencies such as the National Bureau of Investigation.
